answer.rationale: p99 write latency 5x target during peak settlement suggests resource contention. Memory_b3 demonstrates that provisioning headroom absorbed surge and maintained performance (queue depth stayed flat). Compliance explicitly blocks rollback of the security-patched release. Regional failover (memory_b2) risks violating the security requirement if not all regions have the release and cannot address a global release-induced issue. Circuit breakers and read replicas target reads or dependencies, not the write path. Adding capacity directly mitigates the most probable root cause (resource exhaustion) while preserving all writes and the mandatory patch.
